Lead PM — Investing, consumer neobank, London hybrid.

Pocketbank (London, 140 people, Series C, profitable) is a UK neobank with current accounts, savings and a credit-builder card. We're adding stocks and, later, a small crypto-buying feature through a regulated partner — we are not a crypto company. We're hiring a Lead PM to own the investing area, leading two PMs. Hybrid, two days a week. You've shipped regulated consumer-finance product and can run pricing and activation experiments.

label_v2.edge_note: a crypto feature at a non-crypto company does not trigger the crypto-native filter
